text: Artificial intelligence is becoming part of our daily lives, so we must think about ethics. One major problem is bias. If AI learns from unfair data, it can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or even medicine. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also important because AI often collects personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it safely. Transparency means people should understand how AI makes decisions, not just accept them blindly. Finally, responsible AI development requires governments, scientists, and companies to work together. They must create clear rules so that AI helps society instead of harming it.
